::: {.callout-tip appearance="simple"}
## How to study here
- **🎧 Listen.** Every page has a Listen button. It reads the page aloud, highlights where it is, and
  lets you change the speed and voice. Tap any paragraph to start from there.
- **❓ Quiz as you go.** Lesson questions stay hidden until you tap them. After you reveal one, tap
  **✓ Got it** or **↻ Not yet**. Misses come back for review, and right answers come back later and
  later until they stick.
- **🏁 Mark lessons complete** to fill your course progress bars, earn XP, level up and collect badges.
- **Outline view** (on any lesson) folds the lesson into sections you open one at a time.
:::

::: {#isoe-hub}
Your progress, review deck and badges appear here. They need JavaScript and are saved in this
browser only.
:::
